text:
ben_sales: Quick question from the ACME POC — they're in a sealed site (no outbound), want HSM/BYOK support, signed/offline bundles, and asked for a monthly-ish security patch cadence + pricing uplift. Can we confirm what's feasible for packaging and upgrade cadence?
sofia_se: TL;dr: doable. We support signed bundles + SBOMs. For fully air‑gapped sites we recommend: delta hotfixes every 2–4 weeks and full upgrades quarterly. Monthly security-only cadence is possible but will be operationally heavier. :+1:
mike_security: Clarify one thing — are they asking us to manage keys (KMS) or do BYOK with their HSM? BYOK implies offline key exchange, CSR signing, and an addendum for key custody. cc @lisa_legal
lisa_legal: If BYOK, legal needs a high‑level key handling doc. Also flag export controls and MSA addendum. Ask customer for: who holds key escrow, retention requirements, and any country/regulatory constraints.
amy_sre: Ops notes: delta bundles require the detached-installer v2.3+ on site. Typical apply flow: `./installer apply --bundle ./redwood-delta-2025-06.tar.gz --offline` — verification step: `sha256sum redwood-delta-2025-06.tar.gz` against signed manifest. For minibundles we need a jumpbox or USB transfer with checksum verification.
sofia_se: Packaging options summary:
- Full OCI image (largest, easiest to apply)
- Compressed full bundle (single file, multi-GB)
- Delta bundle (most POC-friendly, ~30–300MB depending on diff)
- Minibundle (runtime+manifest only, weights seeded separately)
For very constrained sites we recommend minibundles + vetted weight-sync plan handled by customer.
ben_sales: Customer also asked about pricing — what's the uplift for signed airgap packaging + weekly hotfix support during POC?
maria_revenue: For POC we can include signed bundles and one minibundle build free for 90 days. Post‑POC: add‑on "Airgap Ops" $5k/mo (up to 3 sites). Weekly hotfix SLA + expedited signing is an extra $2k/mo. Final pricing depends on term and number of sites.
mike_security: Cert rotation ask: they want 30‑day node cert rotation. Recommend 90 days for node certs; 30 days is doable but requires automation. We can offer rotation tooling as part of Airgap Ops (adds to price).
sofia_se: Risks/constraints to flag to customer: offline KMS exchange needs physical handoff or signed CSR workflow; delta bundles can't cover model-weight-only fixes unless weights are present; emergency hotfixes outside cadence may need manual approves and can slip SLAs.
sofia_se: Action items: (1) ben_sales -> send customer KMS/HSM requirements doc + target cert rotation cadence, (2) amy_sre -> produce delta/minibundle checklist + sample signed bundle (sized example), (3) lisa_legal -> draft BYOK addendum template. ETA: EOD Wed.
ben_sales: I'll forward their KMS requirements doc right now. Thanks all! :rocket:
deploy-bot: Uploaded sample signed minibundle to internal bucket (s3://redwood-airgap-samples/1738459200-minibundle.tar.gz) — checksum and manifest attached in the bucket for SRE review.
